topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I don't know how much more of this I can take. Another neighbor, another request. This time, it's about using a part of my yard for a garden. A garden. Of all things, they want to grow things in my space. It's not like I have much of it to begin with, and now this. I suppose I should be grateful for the company, for the greenery, but all I can feel is the weight of one more obligation. I have to say yes, don't I? It’s the neighborly thing, the right thing. But the thought of giving up control over my own space, even a small part of it, is suffocating. I don’t know how to say no, and I don’t know how much longer I can pretend that it’s okay.
